review.fitness_expert_summary: This back/biceps workout has reasonable exercise selection for an outdoor intermediate user with bands and bodyweight equipment. However, it suffers from poor exercise ordering (isolation before compound movements), muscle targeting errors (face pulls labeled as biceps when they're rear delts), and questionable exercise choices like scapula elevation/depression that add little training value.
review.product_engineer_summary: The exercise classification system needs fixes: Face Pull muscle targeting is wrong, compound/isolation flags are missing, and exercise ordering logic isn't enforcing compound-before-isolation. The obscure exercise filter should also catch low-value movements like scapula elevation/depression when better alternatives exist.

issues.description: Scapula elevation/depression is an obscure movement when Band Pull-Apart or basic Shrugs would provide better trap training value.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add 'Scapula Elevation Depression' to obscure exercise filter and boost Band Pull-Apart scoring for trap training.

issues.description: Isolation bicep curl appears at position 3 while compound pulling movements (lat pulldown, seated row) should come first.
issues.fix_suggestion: Fix exercise ordering logic in SmartExerciseSelectionEngine to enforce compound movements before isolation regardless of muscle group.

issues.description: Face Pull is incorrectly classified as targeting biceps when it primarily trains rear delts and upper back.
issues.fix_suggestion: Update exercise database to classify Face Pull primary_muscles as ['Rear Delts'] and secondary_muscles as ['Upper Back'].

issues.description: Shrug isolation movement appears after bicep curl isolation, but both should come after compound pulling movements.
issues.fix_suggestion: Strengthen compound-first ordering enforcement in exercise selection algorithm.

issues.description: Thoracic Bridge is an obscure mobility exercise when Band Face Pulls or Superman holds would provide better upper back strengthening.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add 'Thoracic Bridge' to obscure exercise filter and prioritize active strengthening over passive mobility for back workouts.

improvement_suggestions.title: Fix exercise ordering to enforce compound-before-isolation strictly
improvement_suggestions.rationale: Multiple isolation exercises (bicep curls, shrugs) are appearing before compound movements are complete, violating fundamental programming principles.
improvement_suggestions.concrete_change: SmartExerciseSelectionEngine.swift selectExercisesForWorkout() - strengthen compound exercise prioritization logic
